scheme_name: Purchase/Construction of House for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Must have been registered with the Board for not less than three years
Must have a minimum of 10 to 15 years of service for superannuation
benefits_summary: Advance amount of ₹3,00,000 for workers with 10 years left to reach 60 years, and ₹5,00,000 for workers with 15 years left to reach 60 years.
